description: Source code for the PduR module in an AUTOSAR platform, implementing initialization, buffer management, and interface functions for the PDU Router.

methods.name: PduR_Init
methods.description: Initializes the PDU Router with a given configuration pointer, setting the router state to online if successful.

methods.name: PduR_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information about the PduR module.

methods.name: PduR_GetConfigurationId
methods.description: Returns the current configuration ID of the PDU Router.

methods.name: PduR_CancelTransmitRequest
methods.description: Placeholder for canceling a transmit request, currently returns E_NOT_OK.

methods.name: PduR_ChangeParameterRequest
methods.description: Placeholder for changing parameters of a PDU, currently unimplemented.
